Update26 June 2024·All news·Original post on aa-classic.com
Patch 1.2.11
Patch 1.2.11 - The Divine Blessings event is extended by a week - Dying in Halcyona or Hasla will prevent you from teleporting while under the effect of Rebirth Trauma. This effect is zone wide and not tied to the war cycle. - The "Contact Us" and "AA Wiki" buttons on the main menu have been updated to open the Support…

Patch 1.2.11

  • The Divine Blessings event is extended by a week
  • Dying in Halcyona or Hasla will prevent you from teleporting while under the effect of Rebirth Trauma. This effect is zone wide and not tied to the war cycle.
  • The "Contact Us" and "AA Wiki" buttons on the main menu have been updated to open the Support page and the Wiki page respectively.
  • Early 1.3: Increased the chance of a Regrade Brazier to be Hot instead of Warm, as they were boosted in 3.5. Frankly, it would not hurt to have more in circulation at this time.
  • The range on the peace area at the turn-in of the Veroe Harvest Festival has been reduced
  • The Login Tracker for the month of July has been added (we have to do this in the last patch of every month)
  • The Sanddeep Blue Salt Festival has ended
  • With the end of Retail, we're improving the catchup gearset a bit!
  1. Hellforged Gear has been added. Hellforged is a minor upgrade over Soulforged: It provides better stat distribution and is closer to the power level expected at the gearscore of the set.
  2. Waist and Wrists have been added for Hellforged gear sets! This will help players reach 7 celestial pieces easier when they begin their adventure
  3. The Item Level of Soulforged Gear has been reduced to better reflect the powerlevel of that gear due its stat distribution
  4. A quest has been added to introduce players to the Hellforged tier. This quest will be available at level 50 and will reward the player with a Waist piece of their choosing after crafting their first Hellforged piece.

== Patch 1.2.11 ==
* The Divine Blessings event is extended by a week
* Dying in Halcyona or Hasla will prevent you from teleporting while under the effect of Rebirth Trauma. This effect is zone wide and not tied to the war cycle.
* The "Contact Us" and "AA Wiki" buttons on the main menu have been updated to open the Support page and the Wiki page respectively.
* Early 1.3: Increased the chance of a Regrade Brazier to be Hot instead of Warm, as they were boosted in 3.5. Frankly, it would not hurt to have more in circulation at this time.
* The range on the peace area at the turn-in of the Veroe Harvest Festival has been reduced
* The Login Tracker for the month of July has been added (we have to do this in the last patch of every month)
* The Sanddeep Blue Salt Festival has ended
* With the end of Retail, we're improving the catchup gearset a bit!
# Hellforged Gear has been added. Hellforged is a minor upgrade over Soulforged: It provides better stat distribution and is closer to the power level expected at the gearscore of the set.
# Waist and Wrists have been added for Hellforged gear sets! This will help players reach 7 celestial pieces easier when they begin their adventure
# The Item Level of Soulforged Gear has been reduced to better reflect the powerlevel of that gear due its stat distribution
# A quest has been added to introduce players to the Hellforged tier. This quest will be available at level 50 and will reward the player with a Waist piece of their choosing after crafting their first Hellforged piece.
